effect: The skin, arm, supply routes and control systems now form one model, and the goal is to lift and hold the glass.
reaction: Bringing the systems together makes their cooperation clear.

effect: Holding the glass completes the goal and shows that muscle tension, control, supply and skin maintenance continue even when the hand is still.
reaction: The idea that stillness requires continuing cellular work was a satisfying payoff.

mostWorthwhile.text: Lifting and holding the glass brought the systems together in a familiar action and showed why their work continues during stillness.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the supply network to the arm was clear but felt like a necessary intermediate connection rather than a particularly engaging decision.

surprise.text: The outermost skin cells are no longer living, while deeper living cells continually replace them.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the offered combinations had understandable roles, although the compatible options guided the choices.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it connected the assembled systems to a new everyday situation; the final glass example made their cooperation meaningful.
